## 2026-10-01

### Impact

- **Transact now reports the device's WebView provider and version.** Atomic can now see which WebView each Android session ran on, such as Android System WebView or Chrome, and which version. This makes WebView-related issues faster to diagnose, including devices affected by the multiple-profile WebView requirement added in v3.25.0.
- **Sessions blocked by an unsupported WebView are now tracked separately.** Atomic's monitoring can now tell these sessions apart from other errors that happen before Transact loads.

### Changes

- Added the WebView provider and version to the platform info sent to Transact, and recorded a dedicated exit reason when a session closes because the WebView is unsupported

### Products

- Deposit
- Switch
- Manage

| Name       | Compatible | Build Version |
| ---------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin     | 2.0+       | 2.1.21        |
| Gradle     | 8.11.1+    | 8.14.2        |
| AGP        | 8.9+       | 8.9.1         |
| Min SDK    | 23         | 23            |
| Target SDK | 35         | 35            |

| ---------- | ---------- | ------------- |
